name: Chrysoberyl Armaroli
original_name: クリソベリル・アルマローリ
source:
A cleric of a foreign holy church. Personality-wise, she's quite the airhead and a bit of a scatterbrain, but apparently her abilities as a priestess are among the highest within the church. However, she often makes mistakes due to her personality, which is why her standing within the church hierarchy isn't very high.

A series of blunders culminated in her getting lost during a stormy night and by coincidence she wanders into Aruji's inn, becoming its second patron.

She always has a smile on her face with narrowed eyes, and despite being a cleric, her speech and actions are often surprisingly unserious and lighthearted.

Her clothes are so revealing that it's almost sacrilegious to call her a cleric; her attire constantly threatens to reveal more than it should, though she herself is utterly oblivious and unconcerned. However, she treats the protagonist differently, deliberately trying to force even the barely-covered parts into view. Despite relentlessly tempting the protagonist, she is actually inexperienced (a virgin), fitting her role as a cleric. Because of this, she always tries to take the lead by acting like a big sister, yet she also has a submissive side that yields under pressure.

[Translated from the [url=https://kelpy.net/index02/character02.php]official website[/url]]
